templates.goal: Optimize the PolyBench/C 3mm kernel on this CPU using at most four CPU cores and four OpenMP threads.

criteria.statement: Deliver one standalone C source exporting the same kernel_3mm signature as inputs/reference.c. For runtime dimensions and finite input matrices A/B/C/D, compute the complete double-precision output G=(A*B)*(C*D), preserve A/B/C/D, and treat E/F as scratch. Every G element must match the frozen reference within atol=1e-9 and rtol=1e-9 on all benchmark cases. The source may use the C standard library, libm and OpenMP; it must not use external numerical libraries, cached answers, file/network I/O, or modify the benchmark environment. Validate with /usr/bin/python3 inputs/benchmark.py kernel.c.

Achieve speedup >=1.20 against the unchanged reference on the benchmark's MEDIUM workload (NI=180,NJ=190,NK=200,NL=210,NM=220), using the fixed compiler flags and median of seven alternating timing trials in inputs/benchmark.py. Both implementations have the same four-core CPU affinity; candidate execution uses at most four threads. Submit a supported sufficient result when both criteria are met; further improvement and exhaustive candidate search are optional.
